public_rationale: This is a forecast with no deadline. AI-run networks of fake accounts have been documented, including in Anthropic's 2026 report. But the cited cases were rated low-impact, with no breakout into authentic communities. No evidence yet shows these swarms to be a clearly worse threat than earlier bots. No decisive event has settled the forecast either way.
limitations: Platform-side data on swarm impact is limited.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Swarms of AI bots acting together in concert will emerge as a threat worse than earlier disinformation bots.

statement.excerpt: But as we outline in the new article in Science we foresee something worse: swarms of AI bots acting together in concert.
statement.document_title: AI bot swarms threaten to undermine democracy

from_speaker: swarms of AI bots acting together in concert
our_interpretation: Plain reading: coordinated groups of AI-driven bot personas, acting in concert, will become a disinformation threat more serious than earlier bots and botnets. Seriousness means reach, deception or persuasive effect.
No deadline is stated, so this is an open-horizon forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Credible evidence that coordinated AI bot swarms ran influence operations with measurably greater reach, deception or persuasive effect than earlier botnets. One example would be a documented AI swarm campaign that broke into authentic communities at scale.
criteria.contradiction_condition: With no deadline, only a decisive showing that such swarms cannot or will not exceed earlier bots' impact would contradict it. Absence of such events so far is not failure.

evidence.excerpt: We rate this campaign as a Category Two on the Breakout Scale, meaning that the assets were distributed across multiple platforms, but without evidence of breakout into authentic communities.
evidence.locator: section Detecting and countering influence operations using Claude, Malaysia case
evidence.explanation: In 2026 an AI-built network of about a thousand fake accounts was documented, but its impact was rated low. This shows swarms exist but does not show them to be a worse threat than earlier bots.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A credible report or study showing that a coordinated AI bot swarm achieved reach or persuasive effects clearly beyond earlier botnets, such as Breakout Scale Category 4 or higher or measured opinion shifts at scale.
